definitions.explanation: A deep, often religiously or spiritually motivated respect and devotion toward a deity, sacred figure, or person of great virtue. Stronger and more solemn than ordinary respect.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{崇敬|すうけい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{崇敬|すうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧だ。
examples.english: It is a shrine that commands great reverence from the local people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{崇敬|すうけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たれていた→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: He was held in deep reverence by many disciples.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{千年|せんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって{崇敬|すうけい}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧きた。
examples.english: This temple has been venerated for a thousand years.

notes:
Composed of {崇|すう} (revere, worship) and {敬|けい} (respect, honor). The word conveys a level of respect that goes beyond ordinary admiration — it implies awe, devotion, and often a spiritual dimension. Most commonly used in religious and historical contexts.

In Shinto, {崇敬|すうけい}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (devotee) refers to someone who regularly supports and worships at a particular shrine without being a member of the parish ({氏子|うじこ}). Many shrines have {崇敬|すうけい}⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (devotee associations) that visitors can join.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {崇敬|すうけい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to revere, to venerate
- {崇敬|すうけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧: feelings of reverence
- {崇敬|すうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to command reverence
- {崇敬|すうけい}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: devotee; worshipper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{尊敬|そんけい}→尊敬：01454_sonkei⟧: respect, esteem — general respect for a person's character or achievements; less solemn than {崇敬|すうけい}
- ⟦{崇拝|すうはい}→崇拝：10032_suuhai⟧: worship, adoration — stronger than {崇敬|すうけい}; can imply blind or excessive devotion
- ⟦{敬意|けいい}→敬意：02781_keii⟧: respect, deference — more formal and intellectual; lacks the spiritual connotation
